# NBA Store

> > Official online retail destination for authentic NBA jerseys, Nike apparel, and licensed merchandise for all 30 NBA teams.

The NBA Store is the league's official e-commerce platform, offering fans access to authentic team gear, player jerseys, and exclusive basketball merchandise. As the authorized retailer for NBA-licensed products, the store features comprehensive collections for every franchise including the Lakers, Warriors, Celtics, and all other teams.
